paragraphs: “Joining DJ X, the lineup of voices includes seven new English options spanning British, American, Irish, Australian, and Indian accents, along with two new voice options in Spanish. Whether you’re looking for a familiar sound or a fresh perspective, the expanded lineup gives you more ways to shape your DJ experience,” the Spotify team said today.
Different voices, same great taste in music. Meet the new voices of Spotify DJ and pick your favorite 🎧 pic.twitter.com/h4meJmhLI3

The new voices are rolling out to Premium users in the 75+ markets where Spotify’s DJ is already available. Earlier this year, in addition to English and Spanish, the AI DJ added support for French, German, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Spotify said today that its AI DJ, which offers personalized playlists with context and commentary, has become one of its “most popular Premium features.” The new option to choose the voice and commentary settings is available from the three-dot menu in the Spotify mobile app.

The DJ feature is the most annoying feature in Spotify, except for the home page which will never let me just look at Music and specifically at my music. I have zero interest in their Podcast and Audiobook features, but they are always there, awaiting an errant tap.
The feature is also getting a new option to turn off commentary between songs, making the experience less distracting during parties and other moments of conviviality.
